summary: Expand Energy Corporation filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026, reporting Amendment No. 1 to its Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated September 30, 2025, with lenders and JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as administrative agent. The amendment extends the facility's maturity date by one year, from September 30, 2030 to September 30, 2031. Item 2.03 notes creation of a direct financial obligation under the agreement. No pricing, stake, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; no structural overhang or regulatory clock.
